title: Sumant Sinha's bet on a greener India
summary: Every transformative business begins with a bold decision. In his conversation with BBC Business Daily, ReNew Founder, Chairman and CEO Sumant Sinha reflects on what inspired him to leave a successful corporate career and build ReNew in 2011 with a vision for a cleaner energy future. Today, that vision continues to help accelerate India’s transition to sustainable growth. Listen to the conversation
body_markdown:
Every transformative business begins with a bold decision.


In his conversation with BBC Business Daily, ReNew Founder, Chairman and CEO Sumant Sinha reflects on what inspired him to leave a successful corporate career and build ReNew in 2011 with a vision for a cleaner energy future. Today, that vision continues to help accelerate India’s transition to sustainable growth.
